comp_req__launch_man__aslr_support.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching process with
:term:`ASLR` (Address Space Layout Randomization).
comp_req__launch_man__aslr_support.title: ASLR support

comp_req__launch_man__capability_support.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching :term:`Processes <Process>`
with configured OS-specific capabilities and privileges.
comp_req__launch_man__capability_support.title: Process capability support

comp_req__launch_man__central_default_de.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to centrally define defaults for specific properties for the set of executables.
comp_req__launch_man__central_default_de.title: Global process properties

comp_req__launch_man__check_dependency_e.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a method to check if at least one dependency has been executed.
comp_req__launch_man__check_dependency_e.title: Condition check based on at least one dependency

comp_req__launch_man__cond_process_start.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support to conditionally start a process
or process group based on the return value of a single or multiple :term:`Processes <Process>`
executed before.
comp_req__launch_man__cond_process_start.title: Conditionally launch of processes

comp_req__launch_man__condition_check_me.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a method for condition check based on process state.
comp_req__launch_man__condition_check_me.title: Condition check based on status

comp_req__launch_man__config_actions_con.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a way to configure actions based on condition evaluation i.e. to be able to configure SUCCESS and FAILURE case.
comp_req__launch_man__config_actions_con.title: Configuration of action based on condition evaluation

comp_req__launch_man__configurable_timeo.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for configurable timeout
:term:`Interval` to wait for the process to be stopped.
comp_req__launch_man__configurable_timeo.title: Stop timeout

comp_req__launch_man__configurable_wait_.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for configurable wait time
that shall elapse before repeating :term:`Recovery Action`.
comp_req__launch_man__configurable_wait_.title: Monitoring and recovery: recovery wait time

comp_req__launch_man__consistent_depende.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall reject an inconsistent definition of set of executables dependencies.
comp_req__launch_man__consistent_depende.title: Invalid dependency

comp_req__launch_man__cwd_support.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a
given :term:`Working Directory`.
comp_req__launch_man__cwd_support.title: CWD support

comp_req__launch_man__dag_logging_contro.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide the possibility to log the :term:`DAG`
in a human readable format, triggered via :term:`Control Interface`.
comp_req__launch_man__dag_logging_contro.title: Logging DAG

comp_req__launch_man__debug_support.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching process with a
given set of debug arguments in debug mode.
comp_req__launch_man__debug_support.title: Launching process in debug mode

comp_req__launch_man__define_swc_depende.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a way to define for each :term:`SWC` (Software Components), its dependencies.
comp_req__launch_man__define_swc_depende.title: Condition check for each SWC its dependencies

comp_req__launch_man__dependency_check.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a method to check if all dependencies have been executed.
comp_req__launch_man__dependency_check.title: Condition check based on all dependency

comp_req__launch_man__dependency_visu.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall have the means to log the current dependencies in a format that can be visualized when requested.
comp_req__launch_man__dependency_visu.title: Configuration dependency view

comp_req__launch_man__detach_parent_proc.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process to
detach from parent.
comp_req__launch_man__detach_parent_proc.title: Process detach from parent support

comp_req__launch_man__drop_supervsion.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support to dropping all surveillance
and failure reaction activities of :term:`Processes <Process>`.
comp_req__launch_man__drop_supervsion.title: Dropping process responsibility

comp_req__launch_man__env_variable_cond_.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a method for condition check for environment variable.
comp_req__launch_man__env_variable_cond_.title: Condition check based on ENV

comp_req__launch_man__ext_monitor_notify.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for external monitors to get
notified on process life status.
comp_req__launch_man__ext_monitor_notify.title: Process state notification

comp_req__launch_man__failure_detect.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to detect and react to failure of the
process launch.
comp_req__launch_man__failure_detect.title: Process launch monitoring

comp_req__launch_man__fast_shutdown_supp.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall support fast shutdown by terminating itself
without considering the started :term:`Processes <Process>`.
comp_req__launch_man__fast_shutdown_supp.title: Fast shutdown

comp_req__launch_man__fd_inheritance.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with
given :term:`File Descriptor` inheritance restrictions.
comp_req__launch_man__fd_inheritance.title: File descriptor inheritance support

comp_req__launch_man__launch_manager_shu.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall support normal shutdown by terminating all
process in the dependency order.
comp_req__launch_man__launch_manager_shu.title: Normal shutdown

comp_req__launch_man__launch_priority_su.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a
given priority.
comp_req__launch_man__launch_priority_su.title: Process priority support

comp_req__launch_man__launcher_exit_shut.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall exit after performing shutdown operation by
stopping all the :term:`Processes <Process>` it owns in the dependency order when requested.
comp_req__launch_man__launcher_exit_shut.title: Launch Manager shutdown

comp_req__launch_man__launcher_status_st.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a way to store the status of the launched process.
comp_req__launch_man__launcher_status_st.title: Launched Process status

comp_req__launch_man__lazy_check.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall check availability of executables in the filesystem only when the executable shall required to be executed.
comp_req__launch_man__lazy_check.title: Lazy check of configured commands

comp_req__launch_man__lm_ext_watchdog_cf.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall support configuring the :term:`Interval` of
the internal health check executions.
comp_req__launch_man__lm_ext_watchdog_cf.title: Launch manager external monitoring configuration

comp_req__launch_man__lm_ext_watchdog_no.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall trigger a notification to an external
:term:`Watchdog` for each successful self monitoring test execution.
comp_req__launch_man__lm_ext_watchdog_no.title: Launch manager external watchdog notification

comp_req__launch_man__lm_ext_wdg_failed_.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall not trigger an external :term:`Watchdog`
notification if an internal health check failed.
comp_req__launch_man__lm_ext_wdg_failed_.title: Launch manager external watchdog notification - failed test

comp_req__launch_man__log_timestamp.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` logs shall contain timestamp information.
comp_req__launch_man__log_timestamp.title: Logging timestamp

comp_req__launch_man__modular_config_sup.content: The launch manager shall provide modular configuration file support to configure process attributes.
comp_req__launch_man__modular_config_sup.title: Configuration file support

comp_req__launch_man__monitoring_process.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for monitoring adopted
:term:`Processes <Process>`.
comp_req__launch_man__monitoring_process.title: Monitoring and recovery: adopted process monitoring

comp_req__launch_man__multi_start_suppor.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall permit an executable to be launched more than once.
comp_req__launch_man__multi_start_suppor.title: Multiple instance of executable

comp_req__launch_man__offline_config_val.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall have a means to validate the configuration offline.
comp_req__launch_man__offline_config_val.title: Configuration Verification tool

comp_req__launch_man__path_condition_che.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a method for condition check for a path.
comp_req__launch_man__path_condition_che.title: Condition check based on path

comp_req__launch_man__polling_interval.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for per condition configurable
:term:`Polling Interval` for launch conditions to be checked.
comp_req__launch_man__polling_interval.title: Conditional launch polling interval

comp_req__launch_man__process_failure_re.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to react to a process failure by
optionally performing one of relaunching the process, stopping the process,
stopping the process and starting another process, or triggering :term:`QNX`
:term:`Operating System` Device Safe State (:term:`DSS`).
comp_req__launch_man__process_failure_re.title: Recovery

comp_req__launch_man__process_input_outp.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support to pass the output of one or
multiple :term:`Processes <Process>` as input arguments to another process.
comp_req__launch_man__process_input_outp.title: Forward process information

comp_req__launch_man__process_launch_arg.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a
given set of arguments.
comp_req__launch_man__process_launch_arg.title: Handling process args

comp_req__launch_man__process_logging_su.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for logging process launches,
:term:`Processes <Process>` exit/recovery, internal tasks, and interaction with external monitor.
comp_req__launch_man__process_logging_su.title: Logging state transitions

comp_req__launch_man__process_rlimit_sup.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a
given set of system resource limits (rlimit).
comp_req__launch_man__process_rlimit_sup.title: Resource limit support

comp_req__launch_man__process_state_comm.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall have a means for the launched :term:`Processes <Process>`
to communicate a state, which represents the launched processes' internal state,
to the launcher.
comp_req__launch_man__process_state_comm.title: Process state

comp_req__launch_man__retries_configurab.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall support a configurable amount of retries in
case error occurs during startup of a component (e.g. file not available) occurs.
comp_req__launch_man__retries_configurab.title: Configurable amount of retries

comp_req__launch_man__runmask_support.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a
given runmask.
comp_req__launch_man__runmask_support.title: CPU runmask support

comp_req__launch_man__runtime_config_com.content: The launch manager shall provide modular configuration files support for configurations coming from `OCI runtime configuration<https://github.com/opencontainers/runtime-spec/blob/v1.2.0/config.md>`.
comp_req__launch_man__runtime_config_com.title: Runtime configuration compliance

comp_req__launch_man__scheduling_policy.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with
certain scheduling policy.
comp_req__launch_man__scheduling_policy.title: Scheduling support

comp_req__launch_man__secpol_non_root.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support to be started with security
policy as non-root.
comp_req__launch_man__secpol_non_root.title: Non-root support

comp_req__launch_man__shutdown_signal.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall implement a shutdown by sending a SIGTERM to
the process. In case the process does not terminate itself, a SIGKILL shall be sent.
comp_req__launch_man__shutdown_signal.title: Shutdown signal handling

comp_req__launch_man__slog2_logging.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall support OS specific logging facilities to analyze the early
boot sequence.
comp_req__launch_man__slog2_logging.title: Logging slog2 and file support

comp_req__launch_man__std_handle_redir.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for stdin, stdout, stderr
redirection.
comp_req__launch_man__std_handle_redir.title: Standard handle redirection

comp_req__launch_man__stop_order_spec.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall permit the stop order of non-dependent processes to be specified.
comp_req__launch_man__stop_order_spec.title: Coordination stop dependency

comp_req__launch_man__stop_process_depen.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to stop a process when all it's dependents are stopped if specified in the set of executables.
comp_req__launch_man__stop_process_depen.title: Dangling dependency

comp_req__launch_man__supplementary_grou.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a
given set of supplementary groups.
comp_req__launch_man__supplementary_grou.title: Supplementary group support

comp_req__launch_man__support_held_state.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process in a state
waiting for a debugger connection.
comp_req__launch_man__support_held_state.title: Launching process in state waiting for a debugger connection

comp_req__launch_man__support_secpol_typ.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a
given security policy.
comp_req__launch_man__support_secpol_typ.title: Security policy support

comp_req__launch_man__terminal_support.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a terminal or a
session leader.
comp_req__launch_man__terminal_support.title: Launching terminal

comp_req__launch_man__time_to_wait_confi.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall offer a configuration of the time to wait before
SIGKILL is sent. In case "0" is stated, the SIGKILL shall be sent immediately.
comp_req__launch_man__time_to_wait_confi.title: Configurable delay between SIGTERM and SIGKILL

comp_req__launch_man__total_wait_time_su.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for per condition configurable
total wait time for launch conditions to be satisfied.
comp_req__launch_man__total_wait_time_su.title: Condition timeout

comp_req__launch_man__uid_gid_support.content:
The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a
given :term:`UID`/:term:`GID` (user name/Group Identifier).
comp_req__launch_man__uid_gid_support.title: Process user, group IDs support

comp_req__launch_man__validate_condition.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to validate the pre-start conditions of the executable using the conditions.
comp_req__launch_man__validate_condition.title: Pre-start validation

comp_req__launch_man__validation_conditi.content: The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to validate the start of the executable using the conditions.
comp_req__launch_man__validation_conditi.title: post-start validation

doc__lifecycle_security_plan.content:
| **1. Security Management Context**
| This Security Plan adds to the process security management guidance all the module development relevant work products needed for ISO SAE 21434 conformity.
 |
 | **2. Security Management Scope**
 | This Security Plan's scope is a SW module of the SW platform <link to module documentation in platform/modules/<modulename>/index.rst>.
 | The module consists of one or more SW components and will be qualified as a OoC.
 |
 | **3. Security Management Roles**

 +---------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
 | Security Manager          | <link to Module's Security Manager assignment or name>       |
 +---------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
 | Project Manager           | <link to Module's Project Lead assignment or name>           |
 +---------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+

| **4. Tailoring**
| Additional to the tailoring in the SW platform project as defined in the process security management guidance we define here the additional tailoring on module level.
 |
 | - Excluded for this module are additionally the following work products (and their related requirements):
 |   - <ISO SAE 21434 reference>: <work product/requirement> - <Argumentation why it is not needed or replaced by another work product or activity.>
 |
 | **5. Security Module Work Products**
 | One set of work products for the module and one set for each component of the module:
doc__lifecycle_security_plan.title: Lifecycle Security Plan

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.
